summary: Maximum average of any contiguous subarray of length k.
mainInsight: Maintain the sum of a fixed-size window: add the entering element and subtract the leaving one. Track the maximum sum and divide by k once at the end.

approaches.name: Fixed-size sliding window
approaches.summary: Update the window sum in O(1) per step.

commonMistakes: Initialising the maximum with 0 when all values are negative
Off-by-one when removing the leaving element

promptVariants: Which technique avoids recomputing the sum of every window?
How do you slide from one window of size k to the next?
options: Add the new element and subtract the one that leaves the window
Sort the array and take the k largest elements
Binary search on the best possible average value
Keep a heap of the k largest windows seen so far
cards.answer: Add the new element and subtract the one that leaves the window
cards.explanation: Each step changes the sum by nums[i] - nums[i - k].

incorrectOptionExplanations.Binary search on the best possible avera: That is a harder variant, not needed here.

promptVariants: Why compare sums rather than averages while sliding?
When should the division by k happen?
cards.answer: All windows have the same length k, so comparing sums gives the same ordering as comparing averages. Divide once at the end, which avoids repeated floating point work and rounding noise.
cards.explanation: Integer sums are exact in Python.
One pass after the initial window.

promptVariants: Complete the statement: Space complexity (excluding the input): ___
cards.explanation: A running sum and a maximum.

promptVariants: What does the algorithm return for nums = [5] and k = 1?
options: 5.0: the only window is the single element
0.0: there is no full window yet
An error: there is no element to subtract
1.0: the average is divided by k twice
cards.answer: 5.0: the only window is the single element
cards.explanation: The initial window is also the best.

incorrectOptionExplanations.An error: there is no element to subtrac: The loop simply does not run.
